cases.severity_reason: P2: conditional response-header data loss on production proxy paths; no universal outage claim.
cases.trigger: A backend response has two allowed Set-Cookie fields and reaches preserve_response_headers.
cases.consequence: The buggy helper replaces the earlier cookie; the client receives only the final value.
cases.independent_reasoning: insert replaces an existing same-name value while iteration visits repeated values.
cases.test_reasoning: The upstream tests create two Set-Cookie values and verify both survive; a separate test verifies the existing hop-by-hop name filter.

cases.severity_reason: P2: exported library correctness/availability failure for Unicode; do not infer a live HTTP/gRPC outage.

route.primary: Exported tokenizer library / UTF-8 partial stop decoding

cases.trigger: An exported StopSequenceDecoder caller reaches the partial scan with check_text é and configured stop éx (or é🙂 and unrelated STOP), after no complete match.
cases.consequence: The buggy byte-offset slice panics instead of returning decoder output. No production router caller was found at the fix or audited main.
cases.independent_reasoning: UTF-8 é has two bytes, so len minus one is a continuation byte and Rust str slicing there panics.
cases.test_reasoning: Upstream local WordLevel/Fuse regressions cover hidden/visible completion, mismatch release, ASCII stops and Unicode text with unrelated ASCII stop; no model download is needed for those fixtures.
